prototype_choice_without_production_requ.input: Compare two dashboard layouts and let me choose one.
prototype_choice_without_production_requ.expected: Build or inspect the bounded prototype, preserve the selected variant as a verdict, and return to shape-design; do not edit production implementation.

explicit_production_request_after_design.input: The approved design is complete; implement the selected dashboard layout in production.
explicit_production_request_after_design.expected: Treat the explicit request as a new production handoff and follow the normal approved implementation route; a prototype verdict alone is not approval.

multi_context_without_map.expected: Stop and ask which real context owns the term or request a real context map; do not create a root CONTEXT.md or a placeholder glossary.

multi_context_with_map.expected: Read the map and the owning context glossary, then write only to the resolved real context.

conflicting_single_multi_evidence.expected: Surface the configuration/evidence conflict and ask the owner which source is authoritative; do not silently rewrite either source.

unconfigured_single_context.expected: Preserve the existing single-context fallback and create the root CONTEXT.md lazily only when the first term is actually resolved.

configured_single_context.expected: Honor the configured single-context declaration: no context map is required; create the first real root CONTEXT.md lazily when the first term is actually resolved, never a placeholder or fictional map.
